skill.name: email-sequence

content.value_statement: Teams need coherent email journeys that match customer stage and intent. This skill turns goals, triggers, and audience context into structured sequences.
actual_capabilities: Plans welcome, onboarding, nurture, retention, billing, usage, win-back, and campaign email flows.
Defines sequence goals, triggers, timing, length, exit conditions, and key metrics.
Drafts per-email subjects, preview text, body copy, CTAs, and segment conditions.
Suggests audience segmentation by behavior, stage, profile, and engagement level.
Provides copy guidance for tone, structure, formatting, personalization, and mobile readability.
Includes an audit checklist for reviewing existing lifecycle email programs.
limitations: It does not connect to email service providers or send messages.
It depends on user-provided audience, offer, brand, and customer journey context.
It does not verify legal compliance for consent, unsubscribe rules, or regulated claims.
It does not replace performance testing with real campaign data.

use_cases.title: Launch a SaaS Onboarding Series
use_cases.description: Create a 5 to 7 email journey that activates new users and guides them toward the first value moment.

use_cases.title: Build a Lead Nurture Campaign
use_cases.description: Turn a lead magnet or webinar signup into an educational sequence that builds trust before a sales offer.

use_cases.title: Recover Inactive Customers
use_cases.description: Design re-engagement or win-back emails with timing, incentives, feedback requests, and list-cleaning decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Welcome Sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a welcome email sequence for [audience] after they sign up for [product]. Include goals, timing, subjects, preview text, body copy, and CTAs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a complete first sequence.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an Existing Sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this email sequence for clarity, timing, CTA focus, personalization, and conversion risk. Suggest specific changes for each email: [paste sequence].
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of a current lifecycle flow.

prompt_templates.title: Segment a Nurture Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a lead nurture sequence for [audience] with separate paths for high intent, low intent, and inactive leads. Include entry triggers and exit conditions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced segmentation for varied engagement levels.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Lifecycle Email System
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a lifecycle email map for [business]. Cover onboarding, retention, billing, usage, referrals, win-back, campaigns, metrics, and testing priorities.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning across the full customer journey.

output_examples.input: Create a seven-email onboarding sequence for a project management SaaS trial.
output_examples.output: A sequence overview with trial trigger, activation goal, 14-day timing, seven email purposes, subject lines, CTAs, and activation metrics.

output_examples.input: Audit our re-engagement sequence for inactive newsletter subscribers.
output_examples.output: A clear review of timing, tone, offer relevance, CTA focus, unsubscribe handling, and suggested edits for each message.

output_examples.input: Plan billing emails for failed payments and upcoming annual renewals.
output_examples.output: A billing communication plan with separate timelines, message goals, customer-friendly language, update-payment CTAs, and recovery metrics.

best_practices: Provide the audience, product, lifecycle stage, offer, brand voice, and desired conversion action.
Ask for one primary CTA per email so each message has a clear job.
Review consent, unsubscribe handling, and claims before sending any generated email.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for generic email blasts without audience or trigger context.
Do not use urgency, discounts, or social proof when the business cannot support those claims.
Do not send generated copy without testing links, merge fields, timing, and compliance requirements.

faq.question: Can this skill send emails?
faq.answer: No. It plans and drafts email sequences. You must send them through your own approved email platform.

faq.question: What inputs improve the output?
faq.answer: Provide audience details, product value, lifecycle trigger, offer, brand voice, timing limits, and the desired action.

faq.question: Does it support SaaS lifecycle emails?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers onboarding, trial conversion, retention, billing, usage reports, referrals, and win-back sequences.

faq.question: Can it write full email copy?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft subject lines, preview text, message body, CTA text, and segment conditions.

faq.question: Does it handle compliance?
faq.answer: It reminds users to validate consent and unsubscribe requirements, but it does not provide legal review.

faq.question: Can it improve existing sequences?
faq.answer: Yes. Paste the current sequence and ask for an audit of timing, clarity, relevance, CTA focus, and metrics.
